provenance.dateSource: FRUS 1945 Vol. VI Doc. 776：Proclamation No. 1 by General MacArthur, Yokohama 7 Sep 1945 ("will today occupy the territory of Korea south of 38 degrees north latitude"; Art. I all powers of government exercised under his authority)

note.zh-Hant: 【tail-1945-09c】非主權：美軍佔領下的北緯 38 度以南朝鮮（駐朝鮮美國陸軍軍政廳）。法理上仍屬日本，之後另議。與 soviet-civil-administration-korea 對稱。
note.en: [tail-1945-09c] Not sovereign: US-occupied Korea south of the 38th parallel (USAMGIK); mirrors soviet-civil-administration-korea.
